scope: CPU child tasks in the optional mixed CPU/GPU source target, using the existing bounded TaskCore and checked CPU ABI.

semantics.placement: Unplaced spawn selects CPU. Explicit devices.cpu() and aliases select CPU. GPU placement remains explicit; device tensors require an explicit download for CPU work.
semantics.evaluation: Arguments and optional target evaluate once, left to right, before admission. CPU-only argument computations are not part of a GPU closure.
semantics.captures: Concrete per-call-site frame/packet fields retain immutable host Buffers and copy float32 scalars synchronously at construction. Repeated references to one source slot share a field. No tensor payload copy at admission.
semantics.execution: The child exports copying CPU descriptors into its own Invocation, calls the existing compiled function, imports immutable results and completes with the distinct scalar/Buffer layout.
semantics.cancellation: Checks before execution and after the compiled call prevent importing or publishing an early-return descriptor. Existing loop polling and TaskCore settlement retain captures until safe cleanup.
semantics.admission: Existing scheduler frame/result allocations, byte/record/queue/worker quotas and packet size/alignment validation. Generated constructors validate host residency, format and rank before taking frame ownership.
semantics.shapes: CPU-only fixed dimensions remain legal. Known argument mismatches reject compilation; unknown preconditions and native callee parameter shapes check in the child.
semantics.gpu_admission: Only actual placed GPU functions and their checked transitive helper closures require dynamic GPU tensor signatures. GPU argument expressions remain CPU work.
semantics.limits: Pure float32 scalar/rank-one/rank-two CPU functions in the existing single mixed parallel block. No nested task creation in these function bodies, mixed-source failure recovery, new types or shared placement-aware task IR. CPU-only target placement handling is unchanged.

coverage: CPU tensor/scalar children admitted before observation
Temporary submitting packets and source invocations destroyed before child execution
Cached tensor outcomes survive frame and scheduler destruction
Independent groups execute compiled CPU entries on two workers; cancel one and preserve the other
Every nominal Metal preparation failure, byte budget, held GPU completion cancellation/deadline/failure, and zero-resource retirement

cli.dynamic_fault: Fixed CPU child dimensions unknown to caller compile, then fail with shape code 1 and no result under 1/2/4 workers.

distributed_execution: Not implemented; design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Scheduler/source integration and correctness work; no speedup claim.
